release_notes.zh-CN:
AskAll 齐问 1.0.3：浮动面板操作全面升级。

新增：
- 浮动面板标题栏新增最大化/还原按钮：最大化铺满视口，还原时恢复之前的宽高与位置
- 标题栏新增搜索历史入口：弹窗式搜索，支持 ↑↓ 选择、Enter 打开、⌘1-9 快捷打开
- 标题栏新增「新话题」快捷入口
- 标题栏按钮分组：搜索/新话题/设置等功能操作移至左侧，最大化/收起/关闭等窗口控制保留右侧

优化：
- 右键菜单/划词注入的问题改为仅预填输入框，由用户点击发送确认，不再自动直发

修复：
- 修复会话时间线中同一问题重复渲染两条气泡的问题
release_notes.en:
AskAll 1.0.3: floating panel upgrades across the board.

New:
- Maximize/restore button in the floating panel title bar: maximize fills the viewport, restore brings back the previous size and position
- Search history in the title bar: popup-style search with ↑↓ navigation, Enter to open, and ⌘1-9 quick open
- New-topic shortcut button in the title bar
- Title bar buttons regrouped: search/new-topic/settings moved to the left, maximize/minimize/close window controls stay on the right

Improvements:
- Questions injected via right-click menu or text selection now only prefill the composer and wait for user confirmation instead of auto-sending

Fixes:
- Fixed duplicate question bubbles rendering twice in the conversation timeline
